shared_style_model.design_positioning: Restrained evidence-first scientific design with flat pale semantic regions in diagrams and minimal white-canvas quantitative plots.

conceptual_framework.composition: Pipeline or storyboard with a clear reading path and one dominant central region.
conceptual_framework.regions: Rounded cards inside dashed semantic containers, with generous white gutters.
conceptual_framework.marks: Rounded boxes, thin connectors, small arrowheads, simple legend samples.
conceptual_framework.strokes: Thin-to-medium same-hue outlines; no shadow, bevel, or texture.
conceptual_framework.fills: Low-saturation flat semantic fills on a white canvas.
conceptual_framework.typography: Sans-serif character; bold colored headings and regular dark body text.
conceptual_framework.emphasis: Use scale and pale area concentration for the hero region; reserve strong hue for headings and focal structure.

statistical_results.composition: Flat 1x2, 1x3, or 2x2 panel grid with bold panel letters.
statistical_results.regions: White canvas, modest outer margins, clear gutters, thin left/bottom axes.
statistical_results.marks: Small circles, triangles, squares, thin intervals, pale background points.
statistical_results.strokes: Fine black/gray axes; dotted reference guides; thin error bars and connectors.
statistical_results.fills: White background with small strong marker fills and occasional pale uncertainty bands.
statistical_results.typography: Serif character for quantitative panels; bold panel letters, regular axes and legends.
statistical_results.emphasis: Pale background and strong focal marks; direct values replace unnecessary chart chrome.

rules: Use no more than three primary hues in one quantitative panel.
Pair color with marker shape or line style.
Use pale fills only for large semantic areas; use strong color on small data marks.

typography.observed: Dual family: sans-serif for the workflow, serif for quantitative figures.
typography.exact_font_status: Unknown because the reference is raster-only.

geometry_and_spacing.panel_letter_position: upper-left, slightly above or inside the axes
geometry_and_spacing.diagram_corner_treatment: moderate rounding for cards; stronger rounding for group containers

marks_and_strokes.axes: thin black or dark gray left/bottom spines
marks_and_strokes.guides: dotted or dashed gray, visually subordinate
marks_and_strokes.diagram_connector: thin line with a small triangular arrowhead
marks_and_strokes.focal_points: larger or darker, with a distinct marker shape

do_not_copy: exact panel counts unless the target science calls for them
